blocks.html:
FRIDAY, DECEMBER 24
CHRISTMAS EVE
CLOSING AT 5PM

Star Buds Recreational Marijuana
Dispensary South Boulder

Welcome to one of two of the newest additions to the Star Buds family located in the breathtaking city of Boulder Colorado! Our Star Buds South Boulder location (previously known as Drift Cannabis) is another amazing addition to our Star Buds brand expanding our reach in Boulder County to better serve our clients located north of Denver. Our South Boulder location is conveniently found at 5190 S. Boulder Rd. just off the exit of 36 only a short drive to NCAR Mesa Laboratory, endless hiking and epic views of the Flatirons! Boulder, known as “the city nestled between the mountains and reality” is just a 30 minute drive from Denver and serves as a giant outdoor playground for anyone who loves the outdoors!

We are open 365 days a year, 7 days a week, including holidays for your convenience. Visit us and see why our dispensaries are Shining High Above the Rest!

No need to wait for a sale. You save seven days a week with our daily deals!

MUNCHIE MONDAY: Buy One, Get One 50% Off Featured Edibles
PHAT TUESDAY: 5G 1/8ths on Premier, Elite, & Connoisseur Shelves
WICKED WEDNESDAY: Buy One, Get One 50% Off Featured Wax, Shatter, Live Resin Concentrates and Vapes
TERPY THURSDAY:

• 10% Off Connoisseur Shelf
• 10% off all CBD products 
TRIFECTA FRIDAY:

• 1.5G Kaviar + Two House Joints for $30​
• 1.5G Kaviar + One House Joint + 1/8th Elite Shelf for $60​
• 1.5G Kaviar + One House Joint + 1/2oz. Select Shelf for $90​
SOLVENTLESS SATURDAY: 20% off Featured Solventless Concentrates and Vapes
SUNDAY FUN DAY:

• 10% off Any Ounce (excludes Shake)
• 10% Off Apparel, Accessories, Topicals with Oz. Purchase​

By carefully curating the industry’s best selection of cannabis flower, vapes, concentrates, edibles, tinctures and topicals we have something for everyone - from the canna-curious to the daily consumer. Whether you visit one of our 19 locations in Colorado or shop online, our knowledgeable staff will guide you through your cannabis experience. Take your time, have fun, and experience the Star Buds difference!

It doesn't matter if you are an every day smoker or just looking for something to energize your mood, our knowledgeable budtenders are prepared to answer your questions and help you find the perfect products to try. We carry a large selection of flower strains, concentrates, edibles, topicals, vape and CBD products but if you can't stop by and browse our selection in store, we also offer online ordering and pickup.

This is my first time visiting Star Buds South Boulder. What should I bring with me?

All visitors must be at least 21 years of age or older and must provide a valid photo ID. We do not accept credit or debit cards, but we do have a cash ATM on site.

Does Star Buds offer any discounts or ways to save on orders?

We run product specials 7 days a week and our one of a kind rewards program offers even more savings. We are happy to provide our MED badge holders and veterans with a discount upon request, and patients currently receiving treatment for cancer are eligible to enroll in the Star Buds Cancer Relief Program.

​

What kinds of edibles do you have?

We carry an impressive amount of THC and CBD infused edibles including delicious cookies, brownies, chocolate bars and gummy candy. Brands and flavors vary by location, but we have something to satisfy every sweet tooth.

I’ve been going to Starbuds consistently since I turned 24 years ago and it is absolutely my favorite. Great brands, great prices, and most importantly.. great staff! Their staff always is well educated in strains, brands, CBD, etc. I just moved to Arvada but I’ll be making the 30 minute drive to see my favorite bud-tenders!

-Alyssa, Google

Wonderful! Just absolutely wonderful! The staff was incredibly polite from the moment I had my ID checked to the moment I walked out. The staff was quite knowledgeable, very forgiving with answering any questions I had. Shop was very well organized and clean. Would recommend this shop to anyone visiting out of town or traveling to this dispensary.

-Bryan, Google

This is a great dispensary! Reasonable prices, HUGE selection. The bud-tenders are always super nice and helpful, and regularly go out of their way to help me! If you’re looking for a dispensary, I would recommend this place.

-Shayla, Google

Great dispensary with a lot of cool stuff! As someone who lives in Texas, it's always a great time coming to a state where this is legal and getting a taste of some quality bud. I loved this place and can't wait to try more.

-Charlie, Google

Best dispensary by far in Colorado. Awesome varieties and the staff definitely knows their stuff! Highly recommended and great prices.

-Gerardo, Google

This is my favorite dispensary! The products they carry are of great quality and the staff is always super chill and helpful! Glad to call Starbuds my "go to" spot!

-Chris, Google
